rules.rule_name: Transaction Date Range Qualification for Amount Accumulation
rules.rule_description: A transaction must have a processing date that falls within the defined reporting start and end dates (inclusive) in order to be eligible for amount accumulation. Transactions outside this range are skipped and their amounts are not included in any totals.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Transaction Within Date Range and Valid?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, and the reporting period has been established with a Start Date and an End Date from the Date Parameters file
acceptance_criteria.When: The first 10 characters of the transaction's processing timestamp (representing the processing date) are evaluated against the reporting Start Date and End Date
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the transaction processing date is greater than or equal to the Start Date AND less than or equal to the End Date, the transaction is considered qualifying and its amount proceeds to accumulation; otherwise, the transaction is skipped entirely and no amount accumulation occurs for that transaction

rules.rule_name: Skip Amount Accumulation for Out-of-Range Transactions
rules.rule_description: Transactions whose processing date falls outside the reporting date range must be excluded from all running totals. Neither the page total nor the account total should be updated for such transactions.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip - Do Not Accumulate Amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, and the reporting Start Date and End Date are available from the Date Parameters file
acceptance_criteria.When: The transaction's processing date (first 10 characters of the processing timestamp) is either earlier than the Start Date or later than the End Date
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction amount is NOT added to the running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) and is NOT added to the running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL); processing moves to the next transaction without writing any detail line for this transaction

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Transaction Amount from Current Transaction Record
rules.rule_description: For each qualifying transaction (within date range and not end-of-file), the transaction amount is sourced directly from the current transaction record to be used in running total calculations.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Transaction Amount from Current Transaction Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully read from the Transaction file, the transaction's processing date is within the reporting date range, and the end-of-file condition has not been reached
acceptance_criteria.When: The transaction is confirmed as a valid qualifying transaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction amount field (TRAN-AMT) from the current transaction record is used as the value to be accumulated into the running Page Total and running Account Total

rules.rule_name: Add Qualifying Transaction Amount to Running Page Total
rules.rule_description: Each qualifying transaction's amount must be added to the running page total, which tracks the cumulative transaction amounts for all qualifying transactions on the current report page.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Add Transaction Amount to Running Page Total WS-PAGE-TOTAL

acceptance_criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction has been identified (processing date is within the reporting date range and end-of-file has not been reached), and the current running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) holds the sum of all previously accumulated transactions on the current page
acceptance_criteria.When: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is processed for accumulation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is added to the running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL), so that WS-PAGE-TOTAL reflects the cumulative sum of all qualifying transaction amounts on the current report page including the current transaction

rules.rule_name: Add Qualifying Transaction Amount to Running Account Total
rules.rule_description: Each qualifying transaction's amount must also be added to the running account total, which tracks the cumulative transaction amounts for all qualifying transactions belonging to the current card account group.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Add Transaction Amount to Running Account Total WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL

acceptance_criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction has been identified (processing date is within the reporting date range and end-of-file has not been reached), and the current running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) holds the sum of all previously accumulated transactions for the current card account group
acceptance_criteria.When: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is processed for accumulation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is added to the running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL), so that WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL reflects the cumulative sum of all qualifying transaction amounts for the current card account group including the current transaction

rules.rule_name: Simultaneous Update of Page Total and Account Total
rules.rule_description: For every qualifying transaction, both the Page Total and the Account Total must be updated in the same processing step. A single transaction amount contributes simultaneously to both the current page's running total and the current card account's running total.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Page Total Updated / Account Total Updated

acceptance_criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction has been identified with a valid transaction amount (TRAN-AMT), the running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) and running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) are both active and in use for the current page and current card account group respectively
acceptance_criteria.When: The transaction amount accumulation step is executed for the qualifying transaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: Both WS-PAGE-TOTAL and WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL are updated by adding TRAN-AMT to each in the same operation; WS-PAGE-TOTAL now reflects the sum of all qualifying transactions on the current page, and WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL now reflects the sum of all qualifying transactions for the current card account group; processing then proceeds to write the transaction detail line to the report

rules.rule_name: Initialize Transaction Detail Report Line Before Population
rules.rule_description: Before populating a new transaction detail line, the report line buffer must be cleared/initialized to ensure no residual data from a previous transaction appears on the current detail line.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Initialize/Clear the Transaction Detail Report Line

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has been selected for inclusion in the report after passing the date range filter and all reference lookups (Account ID, Transaction Type Description, Transaction Category Description) have been completed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system is about to format and write a new transaction detail line to the report
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer must be fully cleared and initialized to blank/default values before any transaction data fields are populated, ensuring no data from a previously written detail line carries over to the new line

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction ID on Detail Line
rules.rule_description: The unique Transaction ID from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to uniquely identify each transaction on the report.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Transaction ID from Transaction Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the transaction detail report line fields
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction ID value sourced directly from the Transaction Record (TRAN-ID) must be placed into the Transaction ID field (TRAN-REPORT-TRANS-ID) of the report detail line

rules.rule_name: Populate Account ID from Card Cross-Reference on Detail Line
rules.rule_description: The Account ID associated with the transaction's card number, previously retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference file, must be placed into the Account ID field of the transaction detail report line. This links the transaction to its owning account.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Account ID retrieved from Card Cross-Reference Lookup

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized, and the Account ID (XREF-ACCT-ID) has already been retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference file using the card number from the transaction record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Account ID field on the transaction detail report line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID value (XREF-ACCT-ID) retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference lookup must be placed into the Account ID field (TRAN-REPORT-ACCOUNT-ID) of the report detail line, associating the transaction with its correct account

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction Type Code on Detail Line
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Type Code from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to classify the type of transaction being reported.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Transaction Type Code from Transaction Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the transaction type code field on the transaction detail report line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code value (TRAN-TYPE-CD) sourced directly from the Transaction Record must be placed into the Transaction Type Code field (TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-CD) of the report detail line

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction Type Description on Detail Line
rules.rule_description: The human-readable Transaction Type Description, previously retrieved from the Transaction Type reference file using the transaction type code, must be placed into the description field of the transaction detail report line.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Transaction Type Description retrieved from Transaction Type Lookup

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized, and the Transaction Type Description (TRAN-TYPE-DESC) has already been retrieved from the Transaction Type reference file using the Transaction Type Code from the transaction record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Transaction Type Description field on the transaction detail report line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Description value (TRAN-TYPE-DESC) retrieved from the Transaction Type lookup must be placed into the Transaction Type Description field (TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-DESC) of the report detail line

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction Category Code on Detail Line
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Category Code from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to further classify the transaction within its type.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Transaction Category Code from Transaction Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the transaction category code field on the transaction detail report line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Category Code value (TRAN-CAT-CD) sourced directly from the Transaction Record must be placed into the Transaction Category Code field (TRAN-REPORT-CAT-CD) of the report detail line

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction Category Description on Detail Line
rules.rule_description: The human-readable Transaction Category Description, previously retrieved from the Transaction Category reference file using the combined key of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code, must be placed into the category description field of the transaction detail report line.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Transaction Category Description retrieved from Transaction Category Lookup

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized, and the Transaction Category Description (TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC) has already been retrieved from the Transaction Category reference file using the composite key of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code from the transaction record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the Transaction Category Description field on the transaction detail report line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Category Description value (TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC) retrieved from the Transaction Category lookup must be placed into the Transaction Category Description field (TRAN-REPORT-CAT-DESC) of the report detail line

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction Source on Detail Line
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Source from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to indicate the originating channel or system of the transaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Transaction Source from Transaction Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the transaction source field on the transaction detail report line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Source value (TRAN-SOURCE) sourced directly from the Transaction Record must be placed into the Transaction Source field (TRAN-REPORT-SOURCE) of the report detail line

rules.rule_name: Populate Transaction Amount on Detail Line
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Amount from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to display the monetary value of the transaction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Populate Transaction Amount from Transaction Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
acceptance_criteria.When: The system populates the transaction amount field on the transaction detail report line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Amount value (TRAN-AMT) sourced directly from the Transaction Record must be placed into the Transaction Amount field (TRAN-REPORT-AMT) of the report detail line

rules.rule_name: Write Fully Populated Transaction Detail Line to Report File
rules.rule_description: Once all fields of the transaction detail report line have been populated, the fully formatted line must be written to the output Report File. The formatted detail line is moved to the report file record buffer and the write operation is invoked.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Formatted Detail Line to Report File

acceptance_criteria.Given: All fields of the Transaction Detail Report line (Transaction ID, Account ID, Transaction Type Code, Transaction Type Description, Transaction Category Code, Transaction Category Description, Transaction Source, and Transaction Amount) have been fully populated
acceptance_criteria.When: The system writes the formatted transaction detail line to the report
acceptance_criteria.Then: The fully populated Transaction Detail Report line (TRANSACTION-DETAIL-REPORT) must be moved to the Report File record buffer (FD-REPTFILE-REC) and the write report record routine (1111-WRITE-REPORT-REC) must be invoked to physically write the record to the output Report File (REPORT-FILE)

rules.rule_name: Increment Line Counter After Writing Each Transaction Detail Line
rules.rule_description: After each transaction detail line is successfully written to the report, the line counter must be incremented by 1. This counter tracks the current position on the page and is used to determine when a page break and new page headers are required.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Increment Line Counter by 1 to track current page position

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction detail line has been successfully written to the Report File
acceptance_criteria.When: The system completes the write operation for a transaction detail line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Line Counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) must be incremented by exactly 1 to reflect that one additional line has been written on the current page, enabling the page break logic to correctly determine when the page size limit has been reached

rules.rule_name: Transaction Detail Line Must Contain All Eight Required Data Fields
rules.rule_description: A complete transaction detail line written to the report must contain all eight required data fields: Transaction ID, Account ID, Transaction Type Code, Transaction Type Description, Transaction Category Code, Transaction Category Description, Transaction Source, and Transaction Amount. Data is sourced from the transaction record directly or from reference file lookups.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format and write a single transaction detail line to the report containing transaction ID, account ID, transaction type code, transaction type description, category code, category description, transaction source, and transaction amount

acceptance_criteria.Given: A transaction record has passed the date range filter and all reference lookups have been successfully completed — Account ID from Card Cross-Reference, Transaction Type Description from Transaction Type file, and Transaction Category Description from Transaction Category file using the composite key of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code
acceptance_criteria.When: The system formats and writes a transaction detail line to the report
acceptance_criteria.Then: The detail line written to the Report File must contain all eight fields populated as follows: Transaction ID from the transaction record, Account ID from the Card Cross-Reference lookup, Transaction Type Code from the transaction record, Transaction Type Description from the Transaction Type lookup, Transaction Category Code from the transaction record, Transaction Category Description from the Transaction Category lookup, Transaction Source from the transaction record, and Transaction Amount from the transaction record

rules.rule_name: Add Last Transaction Amount to Final Page Total and Account Total at End of File
rules.rule_description: When the end of the transaction file is reached, the last transaction's amount must be included in both the running page total and the account total before any final totals are written to the report.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Add Last Transaction Amount
to Running Page Total
and Account Total

acceptance_criteria.Given: The end of the transaction file has been detected and the last transaction record has been read, with a transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) available
acceptance_criteria.When: The program reaches the end-of-file condition after attempting to read the next transaction
acceptance_criteria.Then: The last transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) must be added to the running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) and simultaneously added to the running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL), ensuring neither total misses the final transaction

rules.rule_name: Format Final Page Total for Report Output
rules.rule_description: Before writing the final page total line to the report, the accumulated page total value must be moved into the report output record layout so it is correctly formatted for printing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Final Page Total
for Report Output

acceptance_criteria.Given: The end of the transaction file has been reached and the last transaction amount has been added to the page total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares to write the final page total line to the report
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current Page Total value (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) must be moved into the report page total field (REPT-PAGE-TOTAL), and the formatted Page Totals report record (REPORT-PAGE-TOTALS) must be placed into the report output record (FD-REPTFILE-REC) ready for writing

rules.rule_name: Write Final Page Total Line to Report File
rules.rule_description: The formatted final page total record must be physically written to the output report file to appear as the last page subtotal in the report.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Write Final Page Total
Line to Report

acceptance_criteria.Given: The final page total has been formatted into the report output record (FD-REPTFILE-REC) containing the page total amount (REPT-PAGE-TOTAL)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program executes the write operation for the final page total line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The page total record must be written to the Report File (REPORT-FILE) as a new line, and the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) must be incremented by 1 to reflect the new line added to the report

rules.rule_name: Accumulate Final Page Total into Grand Total
rules.rule_description: After writing the final page total to the report, the page total amount must be added to the grand total accumulator so that the grand total reflects the complete sum of all transactions across all pages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Add Final Page Total
to Grand Total Accumulator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The final page total line has been written to the report and the current Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) holds the sum of transactions on the last page
acceptance_criteria.When: The program processes the end-of-file page total finalization
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) must be added to the Grand Total accumulator (WS-GRAND-TOTAL), ensuring the Grand Total represents the cumulative sum of all page totals including the final page

rules.rule_name: Reset Page Total to Zero After Writing Final Page Total
rules.rule_description: After the final page total has been written to the report and added to the grand total, the page total accumulator must be reset to zero to ensure no double-counting occurs when the grand total is subsequently written.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Reset Page Total
to Zero

acceptance_criteria.Given: The final page total has been written to the report and its value has been added to the Grand Total accumulator (WS-GRAND-TOTAL)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program completes the final page total writing step
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Page Total accumulator (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) must be reset to zero (0) before proceeding to write the grand total, preventing any carry-over of the page total into subsequent calculations

    EOF_DETECTED --> ADD_TOTALS
    ADD_TOTALS --> FORMAT_PAGE
    FORMAT_PAGE --> WRITE_PAGE
    WRITE_PAGE --> ROLL_GRAND
    ROLL_GRAND --> RESET_PAGE
    RESET_PAGE --> END_PAGE

rules.rule_name: Add Final Transaction Amount to Page and Account Totals at End of File
rules.rule_description: When the end of the transaction file is detected, the last transaction's amount must be added to both the running page total and the running account total accumulators before any final totals are written to the report.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Add Final Transaction Amount
to Running Page Total
and Running Account Total

acceptance_criteria.Given: The end of the transaction file has been detected and the last transaction record has been read, with a valid Transaction Amount available and running Page Total and Account Total accumulators holding values accumulated so far for the current page and current account group
acceptance_criteria.When: The program detects that no more transaction records are available (End-of-File condition is true)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Amount from the last transaction record must be added to the Running Page Total accumulator AND simultaneously added to the Running Account Total accumulator, so that the final transaction's amount is fully reflected in both totals before the final page total and grand total are written to the report

rules.rule_name: Format Final Page Total for Report Output
rules.rule_description: Before writing the final page total line to the report, the accumulated page total value must be moved into the designated report output field so it is correctly formatted for printing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Format Final Page Total
for Report Output

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Running Page Total accumulator holds the final accumulated page total (including the last transaction amount just added) and the report output record layout for page totals is available
acceptance_criteria.When: The program is preparing to write the final page total line to the report
acceptance_criteria.Then: The value in the Running Page Total accumulator must be moved into the Report Page Total output field within the Page Totals report record layout, making it ready for writing to the report file

rules.rule_name: Write Final Page Total Line to Report
rules.rule_description: The formatted final page total record must be physically written as a line to the transaction report output file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Write Final Page Total
Line to Report

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Report Page Total output field has been populated with the final page total value and the Page Totals report record is fully formatted and ready for output
acceptance_criteria.When: The program writes the final page total to the report
acceptance_criteria.Then: The formatted Page Totals report record must be written as a line to the Report output file, and the line counter must be incremented by 1 to reflect the new line written

rules.rule_name: Roll Final Page Total into Grand Total Accumulator
rules.rule_description: After writing the final page total line, the page total amount must be added to the Grand Total accumulator so the Grand Total reflects the complete sum of all transactions across all pages.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Roll Final Page Total
into Grand Total Accumulator

acceptance_criteria.Given: The final page total line has been written to the report and the Grand Total accumulator holds the sum of all previously completed page totals
acceptance_criteria.When: The final page total has been written to the report
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Running Page Total value must be added to the Grand Total accumulator, ensuring the Grand Total now represents the cumulative sum of all transaction amounts processed across the entire report including the final page

rules.rule_name: Reset Page Total Accumulator to Zero After Final Page Total is Written
rules.rule_description: After the final page total has been written to the report and rolled into the grand total, the page total accumulator must be reset to zero to ensure no stale value carries forward.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Reset Page Total
Accumulator to Zero

acceptance_criteria.Given: The final page total has been written to the report and the page total value has been added to the Grand Total accumulator
acceptance_criteria.When: The rolling of the page total into the grand total is complete
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Running Page Total accumulator must be reset to zero, ensuring it no longer holds any value before the program proceeds to write the Grand Total to the report

rules.rule_name: Grand Total Accumulation from Page Totals
rules.rule_description: The Grand Total is built incrementally by adding each Page Total to the running Grand Total each time a page boundary is reached. This ensures the Grand Total represents the sum of all transaction amounts across all pages and accounts in the report.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Transfer accumulated Grand Total to Report Grand Total field

acceptance_criteria.Given: A page boundary has been reached and the current Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) has been written to the report as a Page Total summary line
acceptance_criteria.When: The Page Total writing process completes for any page during report generation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The current Page Total amount (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) is added to the running Grand Total (WS-GRAND-TOTAL), accumulating the total across all pages, and the Page Total is then reset to zero for the next page

rules.rule_name: Grand Total Writing Triggered at End of Transaction File
rules.rule_description: When all transactions in the transaction file have been processed and the end of file is reached, the program must finalize the report by writing the final page totals and then the grand total as the last summary line of the report.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End of Transaction File Reached

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is processing transactions in a loop and has been reading from the Transaction File
acceptance_criteria.When: The end of the Transaction File is reached (End-of-File indicator is set to 'Y') and the inner condition check confirms End-of-File is no longer 'N'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The last transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is added to both the Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) and Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL), the final Page Totals are written to the report (which also adds the final Page Total to the Grand Total), and then the Grand Total writing process is triggered as the final step

rules.rule_name: Grand Total Transfer to Report Output Field
rules.rule_description: Before writing the Grand Total summary line to the report, the accumulated Grand Total value must be transferred from the working storage accumulator into the designated report output field so it can be formatted and printed correctly.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Transfer accumulated Grand Total to Report Grand Total field

acceptance_criteria.Given: All transactions have been processed, all page totals have been written and accumulated into the Grand Total (WS-GRAND-TOTAL), and the Grand Total writing process has been triggered
acceptance_criteria.When: The Grand Total writing procedure (1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS) is executed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The accumulated Grand Total value stored in WS-GRAND-TOTAL is transferred (moved) into the Report Grand Total output field (REPT-GRAND-TOTAL) to prepare it for printing on the report

rules.rule_name: Grand Total Summary Line Formatting
rules.rule_description: The Grand Total value, once transferred to the report output field, must be formatted into the predefined Grand Total report line layout (REPORT-GRAND-TOTALS) before being written to the report file, ensuring consistent presentation as the final summary line.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Format Grand Total as Final Summary Line

acceptance_criteria.Given: The accumulated Grand Total has been transferred into the Report Grand Total field (REPT-GRAND-TOTAL) within the Grand Total writing procedure
acceptance_criteria.When: The Grand Total line is being prepared for output
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Grand Total report record is formatted using the predefined Grand Total report line template (REPORT-GRAND-TOTALS) and placed into the report file output buffer (FD-REPTFILE-REC), ready to be written as the final summary line of the report

rules.rule_name: Grand Total Summary Line Written to Report File
rules.rule_description: The formatted Grand Total summary line must be physically written to the report output file as the final line of the report, completing the report generation process. The Grand Total represents the sum of all transaction amounts across all pages and all accounts within the reporting date range.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Grand Total Summary Line to Report File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Grand Total summary line has been formatted and placed into the report file output buffer (FD-REPTFILE-REC) with the Grand Total amount representing the sum of all Page Totals across all accounts and pages in the report
acceptance_criteria.When: The report record write operation (1111-WRITE-REPORT-REC) is performed for the Grand Total line
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Grand Total summary line is written to the Report File (REPORT-FILE) as the final line of the report, completing the transaction report for the specified date range; the Grand Total value on this line equals the cumulative sum of all transaction amounts that fell within the reporting date range

rules.rule_name: Grand Total Represents Sum of All Page Totals
rules.rule_description: The Grand Total is defined as the cumulative sum of all Page Totals written throughout the report. Since each Page Total itself is the sum of transaction amounts on that page, the Grand Total ultimately represents the total of all qualifying transaction amounts across all accounts and all pages within the reporting period.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Grand Total represents sum of all Page Totals across all accounts and pages

acceptance_criteria.Given: The report has been generated with one or more pages, each page having a Page Total that was written to the report and accumulated into the Grand Total (WS-GRAND-TOTAL)
acceptance_criteria.When: The Grand Total is written as the final summary line of the report
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Grand Total value must equal the sum of all individual Page Totals that were written during report generation, which in turn equals the total of all transaction amounts (TRAN-AMT) for transactions whose processing date fell within the reporting Start Date and End Date range

rules.rule_name: Sequential Closure of All Files After Transaction Processing
rules.rule_description: Once all transaction records have been processed and all report output has been written, the program must close all input and output files in a defined sequence before terminating. This ensures data integrity and proper resource release for all files used during the reporting run.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Program Closure - Close all input files (Transaction, Card Cross-Reference, Transaction Type, Transaction Category, Date Parameter) and the output Report file after all processing is complete

acceptance_criteria.Given: All transaction records have been read and processed, all report lines including page totals and grand totals have been written to the Report file, and the transaction processing loop has completed
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initiates the closure sequence for all files
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must close files in the following strict sequence: (1) Transaction File, (2) Report File, (3) Card Cross-Reference File, (4) Transaction Type File, (5) Transaction Category File, (6) Date Parameter File — and each file must be successfully closed before proceeding to the next

rules.rule_name: Close Transaction Input File
rules.rule_description: The Transaction File, which is the primary source of transaction records for the report, must be closed as the first step in the program closure sequence after all transaction processing is complete.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Transaction File
TRANSACT-FILE

acceptance_criteria.Given: All transactions from the Transaction File have been read and processed, and the end-of-file condition has been reached
acceptance_criteria.When: The program closes the Transaction File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction File is successfully closed; if the closure fails, the program displays the message 'ERROR CLOSING POSTED TRANSACTION FILE' along with the file status details and terminates abnormally

rules.rule_name: Close Report Output File
rules.rule_description: The Report File, which contains all written transaction detail lines, page totals, account totals, and grand totals, must be closed as the second step in the program closure sequence to finalize and persist the report output.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Report File
REPORT-FILE

acceptance_criteria.Given: All report records including transaction details, page totals, account totals, and grand totals have been written to the Report File, and the Transaction File has already been successfully closed
acceptance_criteria.When: The program closes the Report File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Report File is successfully closed, finalizing the report output; if the closure fails, the program displays the message 'ERROR CLOSING REPORT FILE' along with the file status details and terminates abnormally

rules.rule_name: Close Card Cross-Reference Input File
rules.rule_description: The Card Cross-Reference File, used during processing to look up Account IDs associated with Card Numbers, must be closed as the third step in the program closure sequence.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Card Cross-Reference File
XREF-FILE

acceptance_criteria.Given: All card-to-account cross-reference lookups have been completed during transaction processing, and the Report File has already been successfully closed
acceptance_criteria.When: The program closes the Card Cross-Reference File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Card Cross-Reference File is successfully closed; if the closure fails, the program displays the message 'ERROR CLOSING CROSS REF FILE' along with the file status details and terminates abnormally

rules.rule_name: Close Transaction Type Reference File
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Type File, used during processing to look up Transaction Type Descriptions for each transaction, must be closed as the fourth step in the program closure sequence.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Transaction Type File
TRANTYPE-FILE

acceptance_criteria.Given: All transaction type description lookups have been completed during transaction processing, and the Card Cross-Reference File has already been successfully closed
acceptance_criteria.When: The program closes the Transaction Type File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Type File is successfully closed; if the closure fails, the program displays the message 'ERROR CLOSING TRANSACTION TYPE FILE' along with the file status details and terminates abnormally

rules.rule_name: Close Transaction Category Reference File
rules.rule_description: The Transaction Category File, used during processing to look up Transaction Category Descriptions using the combination of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code, must be closed as the fifth step in the program closure sequence.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Transaction Category File
TRANCATG-FILE

acceptance_criteria.Given: All transaction category description lookups have been completed during transaction processing, and the Transaction Type File has already been successfully closed
acceptance_criteria.When: The program closes the Transaction Category File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Transaction Category File is successfully closed; if the closure fails, the program displays the message 'ERROR CLOSING TRANSACTION CATG FILE' along with the file status details and terminates abnormally

rules.rule_name: Close Date Parameter Input File
rules.rule_description: The Date Parameter File, which provided the reporting Start Date and End Date used to filter transactions, must be closed as the sixth and final step in the program closure sequence.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Date Parameter File
DATE-PARMS-FILE

acceptance_criteria.Given: The reporting date range parameters (Start Date and End Date) were read at program startup and used throughout processing, and the Transaction Category File has already been successfully closed
acceptance_criteria.When: The program closes the Date Parameter File
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Date Parameter File is successfully closed; if the closure fails, the program displays the message 'ERROR CLOSING DATE PARM FILE' along with the file status details and terminates abnormally

rules.rule_name: Program End Confirmation and Termination
rules.rule_description: After all files have been successfully closed, the program must confirm successful completion by displaying an end-of-execution message and then terminate normally.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Program End

acceptance_criteria.Given: All six files (Transaction File, Report File, Card Cross-Reference File, Transaction Type File, Transaction Category File, and Date Parameter File) have been successfully closed in sequence
acceptance_criteria.When: The program completes the final closure step
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program displays the message 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C' to confirm successful completion, and then terminates normally returning control to the calling environment

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Date Parameter file is available and contains a valid reporting period record with a start date and an end date
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reads the Date Parameter file at the beginning of execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The reporting start date (WS-START-DATE) and reporting end date (WS-END-DATE) are loaded into working storage, and the program displays the message 'Reporting from [Start Date] to [End Date]' confirming the active reporting period

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reporting Date Range Parameter Loading
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program reads the Date Parameter file at startup to establish the reporting period boundaries (start date and end date) that will be used to filter transactions throughout the report generation process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file and the reporting start date and end date have been loaded from the Date Parameter file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first 10 characters of the transaction processing timestamp (TRAN-PROC-TS) are compared against the reporting start date (WS-START-DATE) and end date (WS-END-DATE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the transaction processing date is greater than or equal to the start date AND less than or equal to the end date, the transaction is included in the report; otherwise the transaction is skipped and the next transaction is read

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Date Range Filtering
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each transaction read from the transaction file is evaluated against the reporting date range. Only transactions whose processing date falls within the defined start and end dates (inclusive) are included in the report; all others are skipped.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has passed the date range filter and is within the reporting period, and a current card number (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM) is being tracked
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card number on the current transaction (TRAN-CARD-NUM) is compared to the previously tracked card number (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the card numbers are different, a card number change is detected and the program proceeds to write account totals for the previous card group (if applicable) and then performs a cross-reference lookup for the new card number; if the card numbers are the same, the program proceeds directly to transaction type lookup without writing account totals

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Change Detection
all_rules.Rule_Description: As transactions are processed sequentially, the program detects when the card number on the current transaction differs from the card number of the previously processed transaction, signaling a transition to a new card/account group.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card number change has been detected and the first-time processing flag (WS-FIRST-TIME) is set to 'N', indicating at least one prior card group has been processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program writes the account totals for the completed card group
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The accumulated account total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) is moved to the report account total field (REPT-ACCOUNT-TOTAL), the account total line is written to the Report file, the account total accumulator (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) is reset to zero, the line counter is incremented by 1, and a column header separator line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-2) is written to the Report file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account Total Writing on Card Group Change
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a new card number group begins and it is not the very first transaction being processed, the accumulated total for the completed card/account group is written to the report and then reset to zero to begin accumulation for the new account group.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new card number (TRAN-CARD-NUM) has been identified, the card number has been set as the current card number (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM), and the card number has been moved to the cross-reference lookup key (FD-XREF-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program performs a direct lookup of the Card Cross-Reference file (XREF-FILE) using the card number as the key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The cross-reference record (CARD-XREF-RECORD) is retrieved and the associated Account ID (XREF-ACCT-ID) is available for use on transaction detail lines for all transactions belonging to this card number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card-to-Account Cross-Reference Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a new card number is encountered, the program looks up the card number in the Card Cross-Reference file to retrieve the associated Account ID, which will be printed on every transaction detail line within that card group.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction record is being processed and the transaction type code (TRAN-TYPE-CD from TRAN-RECORD) has been moved to the Transaction Type file lookup key (FD-TRAN-TYPE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program performs a direct lookup of the Transaction Type file (TRANTYPE-FILE) using the transaction type code as the key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction type record (TRAN-TYPE-RECORD) is retrieved and the transaction type description (TRAN-TYPE-DESC) is available to be printed on the transaction detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Type Description Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: For every qualifying transaction, the transaction type code is used to look up the corresponding human-readable transaction type description from the Transaction Type reference file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction record is being processed, the transaction type code (TRAN-TYPE-CD from TRAN-RECORD) has been moved to FD-TRAN-TYPE-CD within FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY, and the transaction category code (TRAN-CAT-CD from TRAN-RECORD) has been moved to FD-TRAN-CAT-CD within FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program performs a direct lookup of the Transaction Category file (TRANCATG-FILE) using the composite key of transaction type code plus transaction category code (FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction category record (TRAN-CAT-RECORD) is retrieved and the transaction category description (TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC) is available to be printed on the transaction detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Category Description Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: For every qualifying transaction, the combination of transaction type code and transaction category code is used to look up the corresponding category description from the Transaction Category reference file.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction is ready to be written to the report and the first-time flag (WS-FIRST-TIME) is set to 'Y', indicating no transactions have been written yet
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program checks the first-time flag before writing the transaction detail
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The first-time flag (WS-FIRST-TIME) is set to 'N', the reporting start date (WS-START-DATE) is moved to the report start date field (REPT-START-DATE), the reporting end date (WS-END-DATE) is moved to the report end date field (REPT-END-DATE), and the report headers are written to the Report file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Report Header Writing on First Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the very first qualifying transaction is about to be written to the report, the program initializes the report by writing the report headers including the reporting date range, before writing any transaction detail lines.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has determined that report headers need to be written (either first transaction or new page)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The report header writing procedure is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Four lines are written sequentially to the Report file: (1) the Report Name Header line (REPORT-NAME-HEADER), (2) a blank line (WS-BLANK-LINE), (3) the first column header line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-1), and (4) the second column header line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-2); the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1 for each line written, totaling 4 increments

all_rules.Rule_Name: Report Header Content and Structure
all_rules.Rule_Description: The report header section written at the start of the report and at the top of each new page consists of four lines: the report name header, a blank separator line, and two column header lines.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction is being processed and the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) and page size (WS-PAGE-SIZE) are available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The remainder of dividing the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) by the page size (WS-PAGE-SIZE) equals zero (FUNCTION MOD(WS-LINE-COUNTER, WS-PAGE-SIZE) = 0)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page total writing procedure is invoked: the current page total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) is moved to the report page total field (REPT-PAGE-TOTAL), the page total line (REPORT-PAGE-TOTALS) is written to the Report file, the page total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) is added to the grand total (WS-GRAND-TOTAL), the page total accumulator (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) is reset to zero, the line counter is incremented by 1, a column header separator line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-2) is written to the Report file, the line counter is incremented by 1 again, and then new report headers are written

all_rules.Rule_Name: Page Break Detection and Page Total Writing
all_rules.Rule_Description: After headers are confirmed, the program checks whether the current page is full by evaluating if the line counter has reached the configured page size. If the page is full, page totals are written, the page total is added to the grand total, the page total is reset, and new column headers are written for the next page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction record has passed date range filtering, card number processing, reference lookups, header checks, and page break checks
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is accumulated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is added to the page total accumulator (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) AND simultaneously added to the account total accumulator (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) in a single ADD operation

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Amount Accumulation into Page and Account Totals
all_rules.Rule_Description: For every qualifying transaction that passes all checks, the transaction amount is simultaneously added to both the running page total and the running account total accumulators.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction has been accumulated into page and account totals, and all reference lookups (account ID, type description, category description) have been completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction detail line is composed and written to the Report file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The TRANSACTION-DETAIL-REPORT record is initialized, and the following fields are populated and written as a single detail line to the Report file: Transaction ID (TRAN-ID → TRAN-REPORT-TRANS-ID), Account ID from cross-reference (XREF-ACCT-ID → TRAN-REPORT-ACCOUNT-ID), Transaction Type Code (TRAN-TYPE-CD → TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-CD), Transaction Type Description (TRAN-TYPE-DESC → TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-DESC), Transaction Category Code (TRAN-CAT-CD → TRAN-REPORT-CAT-CD), Transaction Category Description (TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC → TRAN-REPORT-CAT-DESC), Transaction Source (TRAN-SOURCE → TRAN-REPORT-SOURCE), Transaction Amount (TRAN-AMT → TRAN-REPORT-AMT); the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1 after writing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Detail Line Content and Writing
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each qualifying transaction, a formatted detail line is written to the report containing all relevant transaction information including the account ID resolved from the card cross-reference lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The end of the Transaction file has been reached (END-OF-FILE = 'Y') after reading a transaction record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The end-of-file condition is detected within the processing loop
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is added to the page total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) and account total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL), then the final page total writing procedure is invoked: the current page total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) is moved to REPT-PAGE-TOTAL, the page total line (REPORT-PAGE-TOTALS) is written to the Report file, the page total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) is added to the grand total (WS-GRAND-TOTAL), the page total accumulator is reset to zero, the line counter is incremented, and a column header separator line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-2) is written

all_rules.Rule_Name: End-of-File Final Page Total Writing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the end of the transaction file is reached, the program writes the final page total for the last page of the report and adds it to the grand total before writing the grand total line.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All transactions have been processed, the final page total has been written and added to the grand total accumulator (WS-GRAND-TOTAL)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The grand total writing procedure is executed after the final page total writing
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The accumulated grand total (WS-GRAND-TOTAL) is moved to the report grand total field (REPT-GRAND-TOTAL), and the grand total line (REPORT-GRAND-TOTALS) is written to the Report file as the final entry in the report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Grand Total Writing at End of Report
all_rules.Rule_Description: After all page totals have been written and accumulated, the overall grand total representing the sum of all transaction amounts across the entire reporting period is written as the final line of the report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program CBTRN03C is invoked for execution
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program starts and completes its execution lifecycle
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: At startup, all six files are opened in the following order: Transaction file (input), Report file (output), Card Cross-Reference file (input), Transaction Type file (input), Transaction Category file (input), and Date Parameter file (input); at completion, all six files are closed in the following order: Transaction file, Report file, Card Cross-Reference file, Transaction Type file, Transaction Category file, and Date Parameter file; the program displays 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C' at the beginning and 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C' at the end

all_rules.Rule_Name: Report Processing Sequence and Program Lifecycle
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program follows a strict sequential lifecycle: all required input and output files must be opened before any processing begins, and all files must be closed after all processing and report writing is complete.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is initializing and the Transaction file (TRANSACT-FILE) is available for reading
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Transaction file as an input source
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction file is successfully opened and made available for sequential reading of transaction records; if the file fails to open, an error message 'ERROR OPENING TRANFILE' is displayed and the program is terminated immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Transaction File for Reading
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction file must be successfully opened for reading before any transaction processing can begin. If the file cannot be opened, the program must halt immediately.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction file has been successfully opened and the program is continuing initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Report file (REPORT-FILE) as an output destination
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Report file is successfully opened and made available for writing report records; if the file fails to open, an error message 'ERROR OPENING REPTFILE' is displayed and the program is terminated immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Report Output File for Writing
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Report output file must be successfully opened for writing before any report records can be generated. If the file cannot be opened, the program must halt immediately.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction file and Report file have been successfully opened and the program is continuing initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Card Cross-Reference file (XREF-FILE) as an input source
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Card Cross-Reference file is successfully opened and made available for keyed lookup of card-to-account mappings; if the file fails to open, an error message 'ERROR OPENING CROSS REF FILE' is displayed and the program is terminated immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Card Cross-Reference File for Reading
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Card Cross-Reference file must be successfully opened for reading so that card numbers can be resolved to their associated account IDs during transaction processing. If the file cannot be opened, the program must halt immediately.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction file, Report file, and Card Cross-Reference file have been successfully opened and the program is continuing initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Transaction Type file (TRANTYPE-FILE) as an input source
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type file is successfully opened and made available for keyed lookup of transaction type descriptions; if the file fails to open, an error message 'ERROR OPENING TRANSACTION TYPE FILE' is displayed and the program is terminated immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Transaction Type Reference File for Reading
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Type reference file must be successfully opened for reading so that transaction type codes can be resolved to their descriptions during transaction processing. If the file cannot be opened, the program must halt immediately.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction file, Report file, Card Cross-Reference file, and Transaction Type file have been successfully opened and the program is continuing initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Transaction Category file (TRANCATG-FILE) as an input source
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Category file is successfully opened and made available for keyed lookup of transaction category descriptions; if the file fails to open, an error message 'ERROR OPENING TRANSACTION CATG FILE' is displayed and the program is terminated immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Transaction Category Reference File for Reading
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Category reference file must be successfully opened for reading so that transaction category codes can be resolved to their descriptions during transaction processing. If the file cannot be opened, the program must halt immediately.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All other required files (Transaction, Report, Card Cross-Reference, Transaction Type, Transaction Category) have been successfully opened and the program is continuing initialization
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Date Parameter file (DATE-PARMS-FILE) as an input source
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Date Parameter file is successfully opened and made available for reading the reporting date range parameters; if the file fails to open, an error message 'ERROR OPENING DATE PARM FILE' is displayed and the program is terminated immediately

all_rules.Rule_Name: Open Date Parameter File for Reading
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Date Parameter file must be successfully opened for reading so that the reporting date range (start date and end date) can be retrieved before transaction processing begins. If the file cannot be opened, the program must halt immediately.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program CBTRN03C has started execution
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program performs its initialization phase
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All six files must be opened in the following mandatory sequence: (1) Transaction File, (2) Report Output File, (3) Card Cross-Reference File, (4) Transaction Type File, (5) Transaction Category File, (6) Date Parameter File; only after all six files are successfully opened is the program considered ready for transaction processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mandatory Sequential File Opening Order
all_rules.Rule_Description: All six required files must be opened in a strict mandatory sequence before any transaction processing or report generation can begin. The program cannot proceed to read date parameters or process transactions until all files are confirmed open.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program CBTRN03C is invoked to run
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Execution of the program begins
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The message 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBTRN03C' is displayed to confirm the program has started before any file operations are performed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Program Initialization Start Notification
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program must signal the start of its execution before any file operations or processing begins, providing an audit trail of program activity.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Date Parameter file has been successfully opened and is available for reading
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program initiates the date range parameter loading step at the start of execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program reads exactly one record from the Date Parameter file into the date parameter working storage record (WS-DATEPARM-RECORD), which contains the Reporting Start Date and Reporting End Date

all_rules.Rule_Name: Read Date Parameter File to Retrieve Reporting Date Range
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program reads the Date Parameter file at startup to retrieve the configured reporting start date and end date that will be used to filter transactions throughout the report generation process.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has attempted to read the Date Parameter file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Date Parameter file read is successful and a record is found (file status is '00')
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Reporting Start Date (WS-START-DATE) and Reporting End Date (WS-END-DATE) are loaded into working memory from the date parameter record, and processing continues to display the date range

all_rules.Rule_Name: Load Reporting Start Date and End Date When Parameter Record Found
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Date Parameter file contains a valid record, the reporting start date and end date are successfully loaded into memory and made available for transaction date filtering throughout the report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Reporting Start Date and Reporting End Date have been successfully loaded from the Date Parameter file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The date parameter record is found and loaded without errors
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program displays the message 'Reporting from [WS-START-DATE] to [WS-END-DATE]' to confirm the active reporting date range before transaction processing begins

all_rules.Rule_Name: Display Confirmed Reporting Date Range
all_rules.Rule_Description: After successfully loading the date parameters, the program confirms the active reporting period by displaying the start date and end date that will be used to filter transactions for the report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has attempted to read the Date Parameter file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Date Parameter file read returns an end-of-file condition (file status is '10'), meaning no date parameter record exists
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The End-of-File indicator (END-OF-FILE) is set to 'Y', which prevents any transaction processing from occurring and causes the program to proceed directly to closing all files and ending execution

all_rules.Rule_Name: Halt Processing When No Date Parameter Record Exists
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the Date Parameter file contains no records (end-of-file condition), the program cannot determine the reporting date range and must stop all transaction processing immediately.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program has attempted to read the Date Parameter file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Date Parameter file read returns an unexpected error condition (file status is neither '00' for success nor '10' for end-of-file)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program displays the error message 'ERROR READING DATEPARM FILE', records the file status for diagnostic display, and immediately terminates program execution abnormally — no transaction processing or report generation occurs

all_rules.Rule_Name: Halt Processing on Date Parameter File Read Failure
all_rules.Rule_Description: If the Date Parameter file cannot be read due to an unexpected error, the program cannot reliably determine the reporting date range and must immediately stop execution to prevent generating an incorrect or incomplete report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction File has been successfully opened for input and the end-of-file flag is set to 'N' (not yet reached end of file)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program requests the next transaction record from the Transaction File
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The next available transaction record is read sequentially from the Transaction File and loaded into the Transaction Record (TRAN-RECORD) for processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Reading of Transaction Records from Transaction File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The program reads transaction records one at a time, sequentially from the Transaction File into the Transaction Record buffer (TRAN-RECORD) for downstream processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A read operation has been performed against the Transaction File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction File read operation completes successfully (file status indicates a normal successful read)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction record is confirmed as available and ready for processing; the program continues to the next processing step without interruption

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Record Successfully Read and Available for Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a transaction record is read without any issues, the record is confirmed as available and the program proceeds with transaction processing logic.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A read operation has been performed against the Transaction File and the read was not successful
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction File read operation returns an end-of-file condition (no more transaction records exist in the file)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The End-of-File flag (END-OF-FILE) is set to 'Y', signaling that all transactions have been read and no further transaction records are available for processing; the processing loop will terminate

all_rules.Rule_Name: End-of-File Detected on Transaction File - Mark Processing Complete
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the Transaction File has no more records to read, the program detects the end-of-file condition and marks the end-of-file flag to signal that all transactions have been processed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The End-of-File flag (END-OF-FILE) has been set to 'Y' after detecting end-of-file on the Transaction File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The main processing loop evaluates the End-of-File flag at the start of each iteration
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The main processing loop terminates because the condition END-OF-FILE = 'Y' is satisfied; no further transaction records are read or processed

all_rules.Rule_Name: No More Transactions Available - End Processing Loop
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once the end-of-file flag is set to 'Y', the main transaction processing loop recognizes that all transactions have been consumed and stops requesting further records.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, and the transaction record contains a processing timestamp field (TRAN-PROC-TS)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to evaluate whether the transaction falls within the reporting date range
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system extracts the first 10 characters of the transaction processing timestamp (TRAN-PROC-TS positions 1 through 10) to represent the transaction processing date, and this extracted date value is used for all subsequent date range comparisons

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Processing Date Extraction from Timestamp
all_rules.Rule_Description: The transaction processing date is derived from the first 10 characters of the transaction processing timestamp field. This date value is used as the basis for all date range comparisons during report filtering.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, the transaction processing date has been extracted from the first 10 characters of the processing timestamp (TRAN-PROC-TS), and the reporting start date (WS-START-DATE) has been loaded from the Date Parameters file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the transaction processing date against the reporting start date
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the transaction processing date is less than the reporting start date, the transaction is skipped and excluded from the report, and the program proceeds to read the next transaction; if the transaction processing date is greater than or equal to the reporting start date, the transaction passes the lower bound check and proceeds to the end date comparison

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Processing Date Must Be On or After Reporting Start Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each transaction's processing date is compared against the reporting period start date. Transactions processed before the reporting start date are excluded from the report and the program moves on to read the next transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, the transaction processing date has been extracted from the first 10 characters of the processing timestamp (TRAN-PROC-TS), the transaction has already passed the start date check, and the reporting end date (WS-END-DATE) has been loaded from the Date Parameters file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system compares the transaction processing date against the reporting end date
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the transaction processing date is greater than the reporting end date, the transaction is skipped and excluded from the report, and the program proceeds to read the next transaction; if the transaction processing date is less than or equal to the reporting end date, the transaction passes the upper bound check and qualifies for inclusion in the report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Processing Date Must Be On or Before Reporting End Date
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each transaction's processing date is compared against the reporting period end date. Transactions processed after the reporting end date are excluded from the report and the program moves on to read the next transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, the transaction processing date has been extracted from the first 10 characters of the processing timestamp (TRAN-PROC-TS), and both the reporting start date (WS-START-DATE) and reporting end date (WS-END-DATE) have been loaded from the Date Parameters file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system evaluates the combined date range condition: transaction processing date is greater than or equal to WS-START-DATE AND transaction processing date is less than or equal to WS-END-DATE
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If both conditions are true simultaneously, the transaction qualifies for reporting and processing continues to the card number processing step; if either condition is false (date is before start date OR date is after end date), the transaction is skipped entirely and the program returns to read the next transaction record from the Transaction file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Date Range Qualification - Both Bounds Must Be Satisfied
all_rules.Rule_Description: A transaction is included in the report only when its processing date satisfies both the lower bound (on or after start date) and the upper bound (on or before end date) conditions simultaneously. Both conditions must be true for the transaction to qualify for reporting.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, and the transaction processing date extracted from the first 10 characters of TRAN-PROC-TS has been evaluated against the reporting date range defined by WS-START-DATE and WS-END-DATE
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction processing date is either strictly less than the reporting start date (WS-START-DATE) or strictly greater than the reporting end date (WS-END-DATE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction is skipped with no further processing performed — no cross-reference lookup, no transaction type lookup, no transaction category lookup, no detail line written to the report, and no amounts added to page total or account total; the program immediately proceeds to read the next transaction record from the Transaction file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Out-of-Range Transaction and Return to Next Transaction Read
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a transaction's processing date falls outside the specified reporting date range (either before the start date or after the end date), the transaction is completely bypassed with no processing, no totals accumulation, and no report output generated for that transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction has passed the date range filter and is available for processing, and a previously processed card number is stored in memory (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card number on the current transaction (TRAN-CARD-NUM) is compared against the stored previously processed card number (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the card numbers are different, a new account group is detected and the program initiates account group transition processing; if the card numbers are the same, the transaction belongs to the current account group and processing continues without any account group transition

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect New Card Number to Identify New Account Group
all_rules.Rule_Description: When processing each qualifying transaction, the program compares the card number on the current transaction against the card number of the previously processed transaction to determine whether a new account group has started.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new card number has been detected on the current transaction, indicating a potential account group transition
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program checks the first-time processing indicator (WS-FIRST-TIME) to determine if any previous account group has been processed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If WS-FIRST-TIME is 'N' (not the first transaction), a previous account group exists and account totals must be written for it before starting the new group; if WS-FIRST-TIME is 'Y' (first transaction), no previous account group exists and writing account totals is skipped, proceeding directly to update the stored card number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Guard Against Writing Account Totals Before First Transaction is Processed
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a new card number is detected, the program must determine whether a previous account group actually exists before attempting to write account totals. This prevents writing empty or invalid account totals at the very start of report generation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new card number has been detected and the first-time indicator confirms a previous account group was processed (WS-FIRST-TIME = 'N'), with a non-zero accumulated account total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) representing the sum of all transaction amounts for the previous card group
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The account totals writing process is triggered for the completed account group
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The accumulated account total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) is moved to the report account total field (REPT-ACCOUNT-TOTAL), the account totals line is written to the report file, the account total accumulator (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) is reset to zero, the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1, a column separator header line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-2) is written to the report, and the line counter is incremented by 1 again

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Accumulated Account Total and Reset for New Account Group
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a previous account group exists and a new card number is detected, the accumulated transaction total for the completed account group is written to the report and the account total accumulator is reset to zero in preparation for the new account group.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A new card number has been detected on the current transaction, and any required account totals for the previous group have already been written (or skipped for the first transaction)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The stored current card number is updated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The card number from the current transaction (TRAN-CARD-NUM) is copied into the stored current card number field (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM), establishing the new account group identity for all subsequent transactions until the next card number change is detected

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Stored Card Number to Current Transaction Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: After handling the previous account group totals (or at the start of the first group), the program updates its stored current card number to the card number of the new transaction, establishing the new account group context for subsequent transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The stored current card number (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM) has been updated to the new transaction's card number (TRAN-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The cross-reference lookup is initiated for the new card number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current transaction card number (TRAN-CARD-NUM) is moved into the cross-reference file lookup key field (FD-XREF-CARD-NUM), and the cross-reference lookup process is invoked to retrieve the Account ID associated with that card number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Card Number as Cross-Reference Lookup Key for Account ID Retrieval
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a new card number is established, the card number must be used as the key to look up the associated Account ID from the Card Cross-Reference file, so that the Account ID can be printed on all transaction detail lines within this account group.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The cross-reference file lookup key (FD-XREF-CARD-NUM) has been set to the new card number, and the Card Cross-Reference file (XREF-FILE) is open and available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Card Cross-Reference file is read using the card number as the key
