Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the card number is found, the full cross-reference record (CARD-XREF-RECORD) including the Account ID (XREF-ACCT-ID) is retrieved and made available for use on transaction detail lines; if the card number is NOT found in the cross-reference file, the transaction is flagged as having an invalid card number, an 'INVALID CARD NUMBER' message is displayed along with the card number, and the program terminates abnormally as the data integrity cannot be guaranteed

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Account ID from Card Cross-Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Card Cross-Reference file is read using the card number as the key to retrieve the Account ID record. If the card number does not exist in the cross-reference file, the transaction is considered invalid and processing cannot continue.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction has passed the date range filter and is available for processing
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card number on the current transaction (TRAN-CARD-NUM) is equal to the stored previously processed card number (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: No account group transition actions are performed — no account totals are written, no card number update occurs, and no cross-reference lookup is triggered; the program proceeds directly to the transaction type lookup step for the current transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Continue Processing Same Account Group Without Account Total Write
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the card number on the current transaction matches the previously processed card number, the transaction belongs to the same account group and no account group transition actions are required — processing proceeds directly to transaction type lookup.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction has been read from the transaction file and its processing date has been validated to fall within the reporting date range, and a previous card number is being tracked in the current card number field
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card number on the current transaction is compared to the previously tracked card number, and the two values are NOT equal
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program identifies this as a card number change event and triggers the account group boundary processing, which includes writing account totals for the previous card group and updating the tracked card number to the new card number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Card Number Change to Trigger Account Group Boundary
all_rules.Rule_Description: When processing transactions sequentially, the program must detect when a transaction belongs to a different card than the previous transaction, signaling the end of one account group and the beginning of another.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card number change has been detected on the current transaction, and the first-time processing indicator is being evaluated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first-time processing indicator is set to 'Y', meaning this is the very first card number encountered in the current report run
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program skips writing account totals entirely (no account total line is written to the report) and proceeds directly to updating the current card number to the new card number

all_rules.Rule_Name: Suppress Account Total Writing for the First Transaction of the Report
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card number change is detected, the program must determine whether a previous account group actually exists before attempting to write account totals. On the very first transaction of the report, there is no prior account group, so writing account totals must be suppressed.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A card number change has been detected, the first-time indicator is 'N' confirming a previous account group exists, and the account total field holds the sum of all transaction amounts processed for the previous card number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The account total writing process is triggered for the previous card group
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The accumulated account total amount is moved into the report account total field, the formatted account total line is written to the report output file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Accumulated Account Total for Previous Card Group
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card number change is detected and a previous account group exists, the accumulated transaction total for that account group must be retrieved and written to the report before processing begins for the new card group.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account total line for the previous card group has been successfully written to the report
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The account total reset step is executed as part of the account total writing process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The account total accumulator is set to zero, ensuring that transaction amounts for the upcoming new card group are accumulated independently from the previous card group

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset Account Total to Zero After Writing
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the account total for the previous card group has been written to the report, the account total accumulator must be reset to zero so that it can begin accumulating transaction amounts for the new card group without carrying over amounts from the previous group.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The account total line has been written to the report and the account total accumulator has been reset to zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The separator line writing step is executed as part of the account total writing process
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The column header line 2 (used as a separator) is written to the report output file and the line counter is incremented by one to reflect the additional line written

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Separator Line After Account Total
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the account total line is written and the accumulator is reset, a separator/column header line must be written to the report to visually separate the completed account group from the next account group's transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Either the account totals for the previous card group have been written and reset, or this is the first transaction of the report, and the new card number from the current transaction is available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card number update step is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current card number tracker is updated to hold the new transaction's card number, and the card cross-reference lookup key is also set to the new card number so that the account ID associated with the new card can be retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Update Tracked Card Number to New Card Number
all_rules.Rule_Description: After completing all account total writing for the previous card group (or immediately on the first transaction), the program must update its tracked current card number to the new card number so that subsequent transactions can be correctly grouped under the new card.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, and the transaction's Card Number (TRAN-CARD-NUM) is different from the currently tracked Card Number (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system detects a card number change and prepares to look up the account associated with the new card number
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction's Card Number (TRAN-CARD-NUM) must be stored as the new current Card Number (WS-CURR-CARD-NUM) and simultaneously set as the lookup key (FD-XREF-CARD-NUM) for the Card Cross-Reference file search, after which the cross-reference lookup process is invoked

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Card Number as Cross-Reference Lookup Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a transaction belongs to a new card number (different from the previously processed card), the transaction's card number must be established as both the current tracking card number and the key used to search the Card Cross-Reference file for the associated account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The card number (FD-XREF-CARD-NUM) has been set as the lookup key and the Card Cross-Reference file (XREF-FILE) is open for input
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs a direct key-based read of the Card Cross-Reference file (XREF-FILE) using the card number as the search key, retrieving the result into the Card Cross-Reference record (CARD-XREF-RECORD)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the card number is found in the file, the associated cross-reference record (CARD-XREF-RECORD) is retrieved successfully and processing continues; if the card number is NOT found (Invalid Key condition), the system identifies the card as unrecognized and halts further processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Card Number Lookup in Card Cross-Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The system must search the Card Cross-Reference file using the card number as the key to find the associated account. The lookup determines whether the card number is a valid, registered card with a known account mapping.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record contains a Card Number (FD-XREF-CARD-NUM) that is being looked up in the Card Cross-Reference file (XREF-FILE)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The card number is not found in the Card Cross-Reference file (Invalid Key condition is triggered during the READ of XREF-FILE)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must display the message 'INVALID CARD NUMBER : ' followed by the unrecognized card number (FD-XREF-CARD-NUM), and immediately stop all report processing — no further transactions are processed and no report output is produced for the invalid card or any subsequent records

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invalid Card Number Stops Report Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: Every card number appearing in the transaction file must exist in the Card Cross-Reference file. If a transaction references a card number that cannot be found in the cross-reference, it is considered an unrecognized card and the report generation must be stopped immediately, as the account association cannot be determined.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Card Cross-Reference file lookup has completed successfully and the cross-reference record (CARD-XREF-RECORD) has been retrieved for the given card number
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system reads the Account ID field (XREF-ACCT-ID) from the retrieved cross-reference record
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID (XREF-ACCT-ID) is made available for use in transaction reporting, representing the financial account associated with the card number for all transactions in the current card group

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Account ID from Cross-Reference Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a card number is successfully found in the Card Cross-Reference file, the associated Account ID must be retrieved from the cross-reference record. This Account ID represents the financial account linked to the card and is the business identifier used throughout the transaction report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Account ID (XREF-ACCT-ID) has been retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference file for the current card number, and a qualifying transaction detail line is being prepared for the report
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats the transaction detail line (TRANSACTION-DETAIL-REPORT) for writing to the report file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID (XREF-ACCT-ID) must be placed in the Account ID field (TRAN-REPORT-ACCOUNT-ID) of the transaction detail report line, so that the report displays the account associated with the card for every transaction in that card group

all_rules.Rule_Name: Account ID Used on Transaction Report Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Account ID retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference file must be printed on every transaction detail line in the report for the current card group. This ensures each reported transaction is associated with its correct financial account identifier rather than the card number.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file and is currently being processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program prepares to look up the transaction type description
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code from the current transaction record (TRAN-TYPE-CD) is extracted and set as the lookup key (FD-TRAN-TYPE) to be used for searching the Transaction Type reference file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Extract Transaction Type Code from Current Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before performing a lookup in the Transaction Type reference file, the Transaction Type Code must be extracted from the current transaction record and set as the search key.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Code has been extracted from the current transaction record and set as the search key
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction type description lookup is initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type reference file (TRANTYPE-FILE) is searched using the Transaction Type Code as the key to find the matching reference record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Invoke Transaction Type Reference File Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Type lookup process must be triggered for every qualifying transaction to retrieve the human-readable description associated with the transaction type code.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Code extracted from the current transaction record is used as the search key against the Transaction Type reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: A matching record is found in the Transaction Type reference file for the given Transaction Type Code
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Description (TRAN-TYPE-DESC) is successfully retrieved from the reference record and stored for use in the transaction report detail line (TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-DESC)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Transaction Type Description on Successful Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a valid Transaction Type Code is found in the Transaction Type reference file, the corresponding human-readable description is retrieved and made available for inclusion in the transaction report detail line.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Type Code extracted from the current transaction record is used as the search key against the Transaction Type reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: No matching record is found in the Transaction Type reference file for the given Transaction Type Code
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The invalid Transaction Type Code is identified and reported, a message displaying 'INVALID TRANSACTION TYPE' along with the invalid code value is shown, and the program immediately stops all processing — no further transactions are processed and no report output is produced

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reject Invalid Transaction Type Code and Stop Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: If a Transaction Type Code from a transaction record does not exist in the Transaction Type reference file, it is considered an invalid code and the report generation must stop immediately, as the transaction cannot be properly described or categorized.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A valid Transaction Type Description has been successfully retrieved from the Transaction Type reference file for the current transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction detail line is being prepared for writing to the report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The retrieved Transaction Type Description (TRAN-TYPE-DESC) is placed into the Transaction Type Description field (TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-DESC) of the report detail line, ensuring the report displays the full human-readable description alongside the Transaction Type Code

all_rules.Rule_Name: Apply Transaction Type Description to Report Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The human-readable Transaction Type Description retrieved from the reference file must be applied to the transaction report detail line so that the report displays meaningful descriptions rather than raw codes.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record is being processed and contains both a Transaction Type Code and a Transaction Category Code
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to look up the transaction category description
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must build a composite search key by placing the Transaction Type Code into the first part of the category lookup key (FD-TRAN-TYPE-CD) and the Transaction Category Code into the second part of the category lookup key (FD-TRAN-CAT-CD), forming a single combined key used to search the Transaction Category reference file

all_rules.Rule_Name: Build Composite Key for Transaction Category Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before searching the Transaction Category reference file, a composite lookup key must be constructed by combining the Transaction Type Code and the Transaction Category Code from the current transaction record.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A composite lookup key has been built from the Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code of the current transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system performs an indexed lookup against the Transaction Category reference file (TRANCATG-FILE) using the composite key
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system retrieves the matching Transaction Category record (TRAN-CAT-RECORD) containing the category description, which is then available for inclusion in the transaction report detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Search Transaction Category Reference File Using Composite Key
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Category reference file must be searched using the composite key (Transaction Type Code + Transaction Category Code) to retrieve the matching category record and its description.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The system has performed a lookup on the Transaction Category reference file using the composite key of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The composite key does not match any record in the Transaction Category reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system must treat the transaction as invalid, display the message 'INVALID TRAN CATG KEY' along with the invalid composite key value (FD-TRAN-CAT-KEY) that was used for the lookup, and immediately stop all processing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Validate Transaction Category Key Exists in Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: Every transaction must have a valid combination of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code that exists in the Transaction Category reference file. If the composite key is not found, the transaction is considered invalid and processing must stop.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The composite key of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code has been successfully matched to a record in the Transaction Category reference file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Transaction Category record is successfully read into the working storage category record area (TRAN-CAT-RECORD)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Category Description (TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC) is available and will be included in the transaction report detail line alongside the Transaction Category Code

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Transaction Category Description on Successful Lookup
all_rules.Rule_Description: When a valid matching record is found in the Transaction Category reference file, the category description associated with the Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code combination is retrieved and made available for the transaction report detail line.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The transaction report generation process has started and a qualifying transaction within the reporting date range is ready to be written to the report
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The First Transaction Flag (WS-FIRST-TIME) is evaluated and its value is 'Y', indicating no transaction has been written to the report yet
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system identifies this as the first transaction, sets the reporting start date and end date into the report header fields, marks the First Transaction Flag as processed (set to 'N'), and proceeds to write the full report header section

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect First Transaction to Trigger Initial Report Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the current transaction being processed is the very first transaction in the report run, which triggers the initial report header to be written including the reporting date range.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The First Transaction Flag (WS-FIRST-TIME) is 'Y', indicating this is the first transaction being written to the report, and the reporting Start Date (WS-START-DATE) and End Date (WS-END-DATE) have been loaded from the Date Parameters file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system prepares to write the initial report header for the first time
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The reporting Start Date (WS-START-DATE) is moved into the Report Start Date field (REPT-START-DATE) and the reporting End Date (WS-END-DATE) is moved into the Report End Date field (REPT-END-DATE), so the report header displays the correct reporting period

all_rules.Rule_Name: Set Reporting Date Range in Report Header on First Transaction
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the first transaction is being processed, the reporting period start date and end date are captured from the Date Parameters file and placed into the report header fields so they appear on the printed report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The First Transaction Flag (WS-FIRST-TIME) is currently 'Y' and the reporting date range has been set into the report header fields
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes the first-time header setup before writing the report header lines
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The First Transaction Flag (WS-FIRST-TIME) is set to 'N', ensuring that the date range setup and first-time header logic are not executed again for any subsequent transactions in the same report run

all_rules.Rule_Name: Mark First Transaction Flag as Processed After Initial Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the initial report header has been triggered for the first transaction, the First Transaction Flag is updated to prevent the initial header setup from being repeated for subsequent transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The First Transaction Flag (WS-FIRST-TIME) is 'N', indicating at least one transaction has already been written to the report, and the Line Counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is being tracked
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The remainder of dividing the current Line Counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) by the Page Size (WS-PAGE-SIZE, which is 20) equals zero, indicating the page line limit has been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The system writes the current page totals to the report, resets the page total accumulator to zero, adds the page total to the grand total, and then proceeds to write a new page header section for the next page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Detect Page Size Limit Reached to Trigger New Page Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the first transaction has been processed, the system checks whether the current page has reached its maximum line capacity. If the page is full, page totals are written and a new page header is started.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A report header section needs to be written, either because this is the first transaction (WS-FIRST-TIME was 'Y') or because the page size limit has been reached (Line Counter MOD Page Size = 0), and the Report Name Header record (REPORT-NAME-HEADER) is populated with the report name and reporting date range
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system executes the Write Headers procedure (1120-WRITE-HEADERS)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Report Name Header record (REPORT-NAME-HEADER) is written as the first line of the header section to the report output file, and the Line Counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Report Name Header Including Reporting Date Range
all_rules.Rule_Description: As the first line of every report header section (both initial and new page headers), the Report Name Header line is written to the report file. On the first page, this header includes the reporting start and end dates.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Report Name Header line has been successfully written to the report file and the Line Counter has been incremented
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system continues executing the Write Headers procedure (1120-WRITE-HEADERS) after writing the report name header
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A blank line (WS-BLANK-LINE) is written as the second line of the header section to the report output file, and the Line Counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Blank Line as Second Line of Report Header Section
all_rules.Rule_Description: Immediately after the Report Name Header line, a blank line is written to the report to visually separate the report title from the column headers, improving report readability.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The blank line has been successfully written to the report file and the Line Counter has been incremented
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system continues executing the Write Headers procedure (1120-WRITE-HEADERS) after writing the blank line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Column Header Line 1 (TRANSACTION-HEADER-1), containing the transaction detail column titles, is written as the third line of the header section to the report output file, and the Line Counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Column Header Line 1 as Third Line of Report Header Section
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the blank line, the first column header line containing the transaction detail column titles is written to the report, providing labels for each data column in the transaction detail lines.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: Column Header Line 1 has been successfully written to the report file and the Line Counter has been incremented
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system continues executing the Write Headers procedure (1120-WRITE-HEADERS) after writing Column Header Line 1
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Column Header Line 2 (TRANSACTION-HEADER-2), serving as a column separator line, is written as the fourth and final line of the header section to the report output file, and the Line Counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1, completing the header section

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Column Header Line 2 as Fourth Line of Report Header Section
all_rules.Rule_Description: As the final line of every report header section, the second column header line (a column separator line) is written to the report, visually delineating the column titles from the transaction detail data lines.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Write Headers procedure (1120-WRITE-HEADERS) is executing and any one of the four header lines (Report Name Header, Blank Line, Column Header Line 1, or Column Header Line 2) has just been written to the report output file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: Each individual header line is successfully written to the report file
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Line Counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1 immediately after each header line is written, resulting in a total increment of 4 to the Line Counter upon completion of the full header section, which is used to determine when the next page size limit is reached

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Line Counter for Each Header Line Written
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Line Counter is incremented by 1 each time any header line is written to the report. Since the header section consists of 4 lines (Report Name, Blank Line, Column Header 1, Column Header 2), the Line Counter is incremented 4 times in total per header section, ensuring accurate page size tracking.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction detail line has just been written to the report and the line counter has been incremented
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The line counter value is checked and it is an exact multiple of the defined page size of 20 lines (i.e., line counter MOD 20 equals zero)
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A page break is triggered: the page totals writing process is initiated followed by the new page headers writing process; if the line counter is NOT a multiple of 20, normal transaction processing continues without a page break

all_rules.Rule_Name: Page Break Trigger Based on Line Counter Reaching Page Size
all_rules.Rule_Description: Determines whether the current report page has reached its maximum line capacity of 20 lines, triggering page totals writing and new page header generation.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A page break has been triggered because the line counter has reached the page size of 20 lines, and the page total accumulator (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) holds the sum of all transaction amounts on the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The page totals writing process is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The accumulated page total amount is moved into the report page total field (REPT-PAGE-TOTAL), the formatted page total line (REPORT-PAGE-TOTALS) is written to the report output file as a new record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format and Write Accumulated Page Total to Report
all_rules.Rule_Description: Formats the accumulated page total amount and writes it as a page total summary line to the transaction report at the end of each page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The page total line has been written to the report and the current page total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) contains the sum of all transaction amounts for the completed page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The grand total accumulation step is executed immediately after writing the page total line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current page total amount (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) is added to the grand total accumulator (WS-GRAND-TOTAL), increasing the grand total by the exact amount of the completed page's transactions

all_rules.Rule_Name: Accumulate Page Total into Grand Total
all_rules.Rule_Description: After writing the page total line, the page total amount is added to the running grand total, ensuring the grand total reflects the cumulative sum of all transaction amounts across all pages.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The page total has been written to the report and added to the grand total accumulator
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The page total reset step is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page total accumulator (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) is set to zero, ensuring that transaction amounts on the next page are accumulated independently without carrying over amounts from the previous page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset Page Total to Zero After Writing
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the page total has been written to the report and added to the grand total, the page total accumulator is reset to zero so that the next page begins accumulating transaction amounts fresh.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The page total has been written to the report and the page total accumulator has been reset to zero
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The page separator writing step is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The column header separator line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-2) is written to the report output file as a new record, and the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1 to account for this separator line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Page Separator Line After Page Total
all_rules.Rule_Description: After writing the page total and resetting it, a column header separator line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-2) is written to visually separate the page total from the new page content, and the line counter is incremented.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A page break has occurred, page totals have been written, and the new page header writing process has been initiated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The report name header writing step is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The report name header (REPORT-NAME-HEADER) is written to the report output file as the first record of the new page, and the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Report Name Header on New Page
all_rules.Rule_Description: At the start of each new page following a page break, the report name header is written as the first line of the new page, and the line counter is incremented.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The report name header has been written as the first line of the new page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The blank separator line writing step is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: A blank line (WS-BLANK-LINE) is written to the report output file immediately after the report name header, and the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1 to account for this blank line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Blank Separator Line After Report Name Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the report name header is written on a new page, a blank line is inserted to visually separate the report name from the column headers, and the line counter is incremented.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The blank separator line has been written on the new page, and the reporting start date (WS-START-DATE) and end date (WS-END-DATE) have been set in the report header fields (REPT-START-DATE and REPT-END-DATE) during the initial report setup
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first column header line writing step is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The first transaction column header line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-1), which contains the reporting start date and end date, is written to the report output file, and the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Column Header Line 1 with Reporting Date Range
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the blank separator line, the first column header line is written to the new page. This header includes the reporting start date and end date that define the reporting period for the transaction report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The first column header line has been written on the new page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The second column header line writing step is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The second transaction column header line (TRANSACTION-HEADER-2) is written to the report output file immediately after the first column header line, and the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) is incremented by 1, completing the page header; normal transaction detail processing then continues on the new page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Column Header Line 2 to Complete Page Header
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the first column header line, the second column header line is written to complete the page header section, providing the full column label structure for transaction detail lines on the new page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, and the reporting period has been established with a Start Date and an End Date from the Date Parameters file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The first 10 characters of the transaction's processing timestamp (representing the processing date) are evaluated against the reporting Start Date and End Date
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: If the transaction processing date is greater than or equal to the Start Date AND less than or equal to the End Date, the transaction is considered qualifying and its amount proceeds to accumulation; otherwise, the transaction is skipped entirely and no amount accumulation occurs for that transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Date Range Qualification for Amount Accumulation
all_rules.Rule_Description: A transaction must have a processing date that falls within the defined reporting start and end dates (inclusive) in order to be eligible for amount accumulation. Transactions outside this range are skipped and their amounts are not included in any totals.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been read from the Transaction file, and the reporting Start Date and End Date are available from the Date Parameters file
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction's processing date (first 10 characters of the processing timestamp) is either earlier than the Start Date or later than the End Date
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction amount is NOT added to the running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) and is NOT added to the running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL); processing moves to the next transaction without writing any detail line for this transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Skip Amount Accumulation for Out-of-Range Transactions
all_rules.Rule_Description: Transactions whose processing date falls outside the reporting date range must be excluded from all running totals. Neither the page total nor the account total should be updated for such transactions.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been successfully read from the Transaction file, the transaction's processing date is within the reporting date range, and the end-of-file condition has not been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction is confirmed as a valid qualifying transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction amount field (TRAN-AMT) from the current transaction record is used as the value to be accumulated into the running Page Total and running Account Total

all_rules.Rule_Name: Retrieve Transaction Amount from Current Transaction Record
all_rules.Rule_Description: For each qualifying transaction (within date range and not end-of-file), the transaction amount is sourced directly from the current transaction record to be used in running total calculations.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction has been identified (processing date is within the reporting date range and end-of-file has not been reached), and the current running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) holds the sum of all previously accumulated transactions on the current page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is processed for accumulation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is added to the running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL), so that WS-PAGE-TOTAL reflects the cumulative sum of all qualifying transaction amounts on the current report page including the current transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Add Qualifying Transaction Amount to Running Page Total
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each qualifying transaction's amount must be added to the running page total, which tracks the cumulative transaction amounts for all qualifying transactions on the current report page.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction has been identified (processing date is within the reporting date range and end-of-file has not been reached), and the current running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) holds the sum of all previously accumulated transactions for the current card account group
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is processed for accumulation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is added to the running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL), so that WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL reflects the cumulative sum of all qualifying transaction amounts for the current card account group including the current transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Add Qualifying Transaction Amount to Running Account Total
all_rules.Rule_Description: Each qualifying transaction's amount must also be added to the running account total, which tracks the cumulative transaction amounts for all qualifying transactions belonging to the current card account group.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A qualifying transaction has been identified with a valid transaction amount (TRAN-AMT), the running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) and running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL) are both active and in use for the current page and current card account group respectively
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The transaction amount accumulation step is executed for the qualifying transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: Both WS-PAGE-TOTAL and WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL are updated by adding TRAN-AMT to each in the same operation; WS-PAGE-TOTAL now reflects the sum of all qualifying transactions on the current page, and WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL now reflects the sum of all qualifying transactions for the current card account group; processing then proceeds to write the transaction detail line to the report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Simultaneous Update of Page Total and Account Total
all_rules.Rule_Description: For every qualifying transaction, both the Page Total and the Account Total must be updated in the same processing step. A single transaction amount contributes simultaneously to both the current page's running total and the current card account's running total.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has been selected for inclusion in the report after passing the date range filter and all reference lookups (Account ID, Transaction Type Description, Transaction Category Description) have been completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system is about to format and write a new transaction detail line to the report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer must be fully cleared and initialized to blank/default values before any transaction data fields are populated, ensuring no data from a previously written detail line carries over to the new line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Initialize Transaction Detail Report Line Before Population
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before populating a new transaction detail line, the report line buffer must be cleared/initialized to ensure no residual data from a previous transaction appears on the current detail line.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the transaction detail report line fields
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction ID value sourced directly from the Transaction Record (TRAN-ID) must be placed into the Transaction ID field (TRAN-REPORT-TRANS-ID) of the report detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Transaction ID on Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The unique Transaction ID from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to uniquely identify each transaction on the report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized, and the Account ID (XREF-ACCT-ID) has already been retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference file using the card number from the transaction record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Account ID field on the transaction detail report line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Account ID value (XREF-ACCT-ID) retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference lookup must be placed into the Account ID field (TRAN-REPORT-ACCOUNT-ID) of the report detail line, associating the transaction with its correct account

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Account ID from Card Cross-Reference on Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Account ID associated with the transaction's card number, previously retrieved from the Card Cross-Reference file, must be placed into the Account ID field of the transaction detail report line. This links the transaction to its owning account.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the transaction type code field on the transaction detail report line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Code value (TRAN-TYPE-CD) sourced directly from the Transaction Record must be placed into the Transaction Type Code field (TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-CD) of the report detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Transaction Type Code on Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Type Code from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to classify the type of transaction being reported.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized, and the Transaction Type Description (TRAN-TYPE-DESC) has already been retrieved from the Transaction Type reference file using the Transaction Type Code from the transaction record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Transaction Type Description field on the transaction detail report line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Type Description value (TRAN-TYPE-DESC) retrieved from the Transaction Type lookup must be placed into the Transaction Type Description field (TRAN-REPORT-TYPE-DESC) of the report detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Transaction Type Description on Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The human-readable Transaction Type Description, previously retrieved from the Transaction Type reference file using the transaction type code, must be placed into the description field of the transaction detail report line.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the transaction category code field on the transaction detail report line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Category Code value (TRAN-CAT-CD) sourced directly from the Transaction Record must be placed into the Transaction Category Code field (TRAN-REPORT-CAT-CD) of the report detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Transaction Category Code on Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Category Code from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to further classify the transaction within its type.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized, and the Transaction Category Description (TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC) has already been retrieved from the Transaction Category reference file using the composite key of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code from the transaction record
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the Transaction Category Description field on the transaction detail report line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Category Description value (TRAN-CAT-TYPE-DESC) retrieved from the Transaction Category lookup must be placed into the Transaction Category Description field (TRAN-REPORT-CAT-DESC) of the report detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Transaction Category Description on Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The human-readable Transaction Category Description, previously retrieved from the Transaction Category reference file using the combined key of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code, must be placed into the category description field of the transaction detail report line.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the transaction source field on the transaction detail report line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Source value (TRAN-SOURCE) sourced directly from the Transaction Record must be placed into the Transaction Source field (TRAN-REPORT-SOURCE) of the report detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Transaction Source on Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Source from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to indicate the originating channel or system of the transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Transaction Detail Report line buffer has been initialized and a valid transaction record is being processed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system populates the transaction amount field on the transaction detail report line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction Amount value (TRAN-AMT) sourced directly from the Transaction Record must be placed into the Transaction Amount field (TRAN-REPORT-AMT) of the report detail line

all_rules.Rule_Name: Populate Transaction Amount on Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Amount from the transaction record must be placed into the corresponding field of the transaction detail report line to display the monetary value of the transaction.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All fields of the Transaction Detail Report line (Transaction ID, Account ID, Transaction Type Code, Transaction Type Description, Transaction Category Code, Transaction Category Description, Transaction Source, and Transaction Amount) have been fully populated
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system writes the formatted transaction detail line to the report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The fully populated Transaction Detail Report line (TRANSACTION-DETAIL-REPORT) must be moved to the Report File record buffer (FD-REPTFILE-REC) and the write report record routine (1111-WRITE-REPORT-REC) must be invoked to physically write the record to the output Report File (REPORT-FILE)

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Fully Populated Transaction Detail Line to Report File
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once all fields of the transaction detail report line have been populated, the fully formatted line must be written to the output Report File. The formatted detail line is moved to the report file record buffer and the write operation is invoked.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction detail line has been successfully written to the Report File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system completes the write operation for a transaction detail line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Line Counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) must be incremented by exactly 1 to reflect that one additional line has been written on the current page, enabling the page break logic to correctly determine when the page size limit has been reached

all_rules.Rule_Name: Increment Line Counter After Writing Each Transaction Detail Line
all_rules.Rule_Description: After each transaction detail line is successfully written to the report, the line counter must be incremented by 1. This counter tracks the current position on the page and is used to determine when a page break and new page headers are required.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A transaction record has passed the date range filter and all reference lookups have been successfully completed — Account ID from Card Cross-Reference, Transaction Type Description from Transaction Type file, and Transaction Category Description from Transaction Category file using the composite key of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The system formats and writes a transaction detail line to the report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The detail line written to the Report File must contain all eight fields populated as follows: Transaction ID from the transaction record, Account ID from the Card Cross-Reference lookup, Transaction Type Code from the transaction record, Transaction Type Description from the Transaction Type lookup, Transaction Category Code from the transaction record, Transaction Category Description from the Transaction Category lookup, Transaction Source from the transaction record, and Transaction Amount from the transaction record

all_rules.Rule_Name: Transaction Detail Line Must Contain All Eight Required Data Fields
all_rules.Rule_Description: A complete transaction detail line written to the report must contain all eight required data fields: Transaction ID, Account ID, Transaction Type Code, Transaction Type Description, Transaction Category Code, Transaction Category Description, Transaction Source, and Transaction Amount. Data is sourced from the transaction record directly or from reference file lookups.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The end of the transaction file has been detected and the last transaction record has been read, with a transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) available
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program reaches the end-of-file condition after attempting to read the next transaction
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The last transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) must be added to the running Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) and simultaneously added to the running Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL), ensuring neither total misses the final transaction

all_rules.Rule_Name: Add Last Transaction Amount to Final Page Total and Account Total at End of File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When the end of the transaction file is reached, the last transaction's amount must be included in both the running page total and the account total before any final totals are written to the report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The end of the transaction file has been reached and the last transaction amount has been added to the page total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program prepares to write the final page total line to the report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current Page Total value (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) must be moved into the report page total field (REPT-PAGE-TOTAL), and the formatted Page Totals report record (REPORT-PAGE-TOTALS) must be placed into the report output record (FD-REPTFILE-REC) ready for writing

all_rules.Rule_Name: Format Final Page Total for Report Output
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before writing the final page total line to the report, the accumulated page total value must be moved into the report output record layout so it is correctly formatted for printing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The final page total has been formatted into the report output record (FD-REPTFILE-REC) containing the page total amount (REPT-PAGE-TOTAL)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program executes the write operation for the final page total line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The page total record must be written to the Report File (REPORT-FILE) as a new line, and the line counter (WS-LINE-COUNTER) must be incremented by 1 to reflect the new line added to the report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Write Final Page Total Line to Report File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The formatted final page total record must be physically written to the output report file to appear as the last page subtotal in the report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The final page total line has been written to the report and the current Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) holds the sum of transactions on the last page
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program processes the end-of-file page total finalization
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) must be added to the Grand Total accumulator (WS-GRAND-TOTAL), ensuring the Grand Total represents the cumulative sum of all page totals including the final page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Accumulate Final Page Total into Grand Total
all_rules.Rule_Description: After writing the final page total to the report, the page total amount must be added to the grand total accumulator so that the grand total reflects the complete sum of all transactions across all pages.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The final page total has been written to the report and its value has been added to the Grand Total accumulator (WS-GRAND-TOTAL)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program completes the final page total writing step
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Page Total accumulator (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) must be reset to zero (0) before proceeding to write the grand total, preventing any carry-over of the page total into subsequent calculations

all_rules.Rule_Name: Reset Page Total to Zero After Writing Final Page Total
all_rules.Rule_Description: After the final page total has been written to the report and added to the grand total, the page total accumulator must be reset to zero to ensure no double-counting occurs when the grand total is subsequently written.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: A page boundary has been reached and the current Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) has been written to the report as a Page Total summary line
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Page Total writing process completes for any page during report generation
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The current Page Total amount (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) is added to the running Grand Total (WS-GRAND-TOTAL), accumulating the total across all pages, and the Page Total is then reset to zero for the next page

all_rules.Rule_Name: Grand Total Accumulation from Page Totals
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Grand Total is built incrementally by adding each Page Total to the running Grand Total each time a page boundary is reached. This ensures the Grand Total represents the sum of all transaction amounts across all pages and accounts in the report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The program is processing transactions in a loop and has been reading from the Transaction File
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The end of the Transaction File is reached (End-of-File indicator is set to 'Y') and the inner condition check confirms End-of-File is no longer 'N'
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The last transaction amount (TRAN-AMT) is added to both the Page Total (WS-PAGE-TOTAL) and Account Total (WS-ACCOUNT-TOTAL), the final Page Totals are written to the report (which also adds the final Page Total to the Grand Total), and then the Grand Total writing process is triggered as the final step

all_rules.Rule_Name: Grand Total Writing Triggered at End of Transaction File
all_rules.Rule_Description: When all transactions in the transaction file have been processed and the end of file is reached, the program must finalize the report by writing the final page totals and then the grand total as the last summary line of the report.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All transactions have been processed, all page totals have been written and accumulated into the Grand Total (WS-GRAND-TOTAL), and the Grand Total writing process has been triggered
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Grand Total writing procedure (1110-WRITE-GRAND-TOTALS) is executed
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The accumulated Grand Total value stored in WS-GRAND-TOTAL is transferred (moved) into the Report Grand Total output field (REPT-GRAND-TOTAL) to prepare it for printing on the report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Grand Total Transfer to Report Output Field
all_rules.Rule_Description: Before writing the Grand Total summary line to the report, the accumulated Grand Total value must be transferred from the working storage accumulator into the designated report output field so it can be formatted and printed correctly.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The accumulated Grand Total has been transferred into the Report Grand Total field (REPT-GRAND-TOTAL) within the Grand Total writing procedure
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Grand Total line is being prepared for output
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Grand Total report record is formatted using the predefined Grand Total report line template (REPORT-GRAND-TOTALS) and placed into the report file output buffer (FD-REPTFILE-REC), ready to be written as the final summary line of the report

all_rules.Rule_Name: Grand Total Summary Line Formatting
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Grand Total value, once transferred to the report output field, must be formatted into the predefined Grand Total report line layout (REPORT-GRAND-TOTALS) before being written to the report file, ensuring consistent presentation as the final summary line.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The Grand Total summary line has been formatted and placed into the report file output buffer (FD-REPTFILE-REC) with the Grand Total amount representing the sum of all Page Totals across all accounts and pages in the report
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The report record write operation (1111-WRITE-REPORT-REC) is performed for the Grand Total line
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Grand Total summary line is written to the Report File (REPORT-FILE) as the final line of the report, completing the transaction report for the specified date range; the Grand Total value on this line equals the cumulative sum of all transaction amounts that fell within the reporting date range

all_rules.Rule_Name: Grand Total Summary Line Written to Report File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The formatted Grand Total summary line must be physically written to the report output file as the final line of the report, completing the report generation process. The Grand Total represents the sum of all transaction amounts across all pages and all accounts within the reporting date range.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The report has been generated with one or more pages, each page having a Page Total that was written to the report and accumulated into the Grand Total (WS-GRAND-TOTAL)
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The Grand Total is written as the final summary line of the report
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Grand Total value must equal the sum of all individual Page Totals that were written during report generation, which in turn equals the total of all transaction amounts (TRAN-AMT) for transactions whose processing date fell within the reporting Start Date and End Date range

all_rules.Rule_Name: Grand Total Represents Sum of All Page Totals
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Grand Total is defined as the cumulative sum of all Page Totals written throughout the report. Since each Page Total itself is the sum of transaction amounts on that page, the Grand Total ultimately represents the total of all qualifying transaction amounts across all accounts and all pages within the reporting period.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All transaction records have been read and processed, all report lines including page totals and grand totals have been written to the Report file, and the transaction processing loop has completed
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program initiates the closure sequence for all files
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The program must close files in the following strict sequence: (1) Transaction File, (2) Report File, (3) Card Cross-Reference File, (4) Transaction Type File, (5) Transaction Category File, (6) Date Parameter File — and each file must be successfully closed before proceeding to the next

all_rules.Rule_Name: Sequential Closure of All Files After Transaction Processing
all_rules.Rule_Description: Once all transaction records have been processed and all report output has been written, the program must close all input and output files in a defined sequence before terminating. This ensures data integrity and proper resource release for all files used during the reporting run.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All transactions from the Transaction File have been read and processed, and the end-of-file condition has been reached
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program closes the Transaction File
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Transaction File is successfully closed; if the closure fails, the program displays the message 'ERROR CLOSING POSTED TRANSACTION FILE' along with the file status details and terminates abnormally

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Transaction Input File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction File, which is the primary source of transaction records for the report, must be closed as the first step in the program closure sequence after all transaction processing is complete.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: All report records including transaction details, page totals, account totals, and grand totals have been written to the Report File, and the Transaction File has already been successfully closed

Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The Report File is successfully closed, finalizing the report output; if the closure fails, the program displays the message 'ERROR CLOSING REPORT FILE' along with the file status details and terminates abnormally

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Report Output File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Report File, which contains all written transaction detail lines, page totals, account totals, and grand totals, must be closed as the second step in the program closure sequence to finalize and persist the report output.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Card Cross-Reference Input File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Card Cross-Reference File, used during processing to look up Account IDs associated with Card Numbers, must be closed as the third step in the program closure sequence.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Transaction Type Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Type File, used during processing to look up Transaction Type Descriptions for each transaction, must be closed as the fourth step in the program closure sequence.

all_rules.Rule_Name: Close Transaction Category Reference File
all_rules.Rule_Description: The Transaction Category File, used during processing to look up Transaction Category Descriptions using the combination of Transaction Type Code and Transaction Category Code, must be closed as the fifth step in the program closure sequence.

Acceptance_Criteria.When: The program completes the final closure step

description:
CBTRN03C is a batch COBOL program in the CardDemo application that generates a transaction detail report for credit card transactions within a specified date range. It reads transactions sequentially, enriches each record by looking up the card cross-reference, transaction type description, and transaction category description, then writes formatted detail lines along with page totals, account totals, and a grand total to a report file. The program is a standalone main/driver program with no CICS or MQ interactions.
- **Execution Environment**: Batch - **Database Access**: VSAM / Sequential Files - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Program Initialization - Open all required input files (Transaction file, Card Cross-Reference file, Transaction Type file, Transaction Category file, Date Parameter file) and the output Report file to prepare for processing 2: Date Range Parameter Loading - Read the date parameter file to retrieve the reporting start date and end date that will be used to filter transactions for the report 3: Transaction Record Reading - Sequentially read each transaction record from the transaction file one at a time for processing 4: Transaction Date Range Filtering - Compare the transaction processing date against the reporting start date and end date; skip transactions that fall outside the specified date range 5: Card Number Change Detection - Detect when the card number on the current transaction differs from the previously processed card number, indicating a new account group is being processed 6: Account Total Writing - When a card number change is detected (and it is not the first transaction), write the accumulated total amount for the previous account/card to the report, then reset the account total to zero 7: Card-to-Account Cross-Reference Lookup - Look up the card number in the Card Cross-Reference file to retrieve the associated account ID for the transaction being reported 8: Transaction Type Description Lookup - Look up the transaction type code in the Transaction Type reference file to retrieve the human-readable description of the transaction type 9: Transaction Category Description Lookup - Look up the combination of transaction type code and transaction category code in the Transaction Category reference file to retrieve the category description 10: Report Header Writing - On the first transaction or at the start of each new page, write the report name header, a blank line, column header line 1, and column header line 2 to the report file, including the reporting start and end dates 11: Page Break and Page Total Writing - When the line counter reaches the defined page size (every 20 lines), write the accumulated page total to the report, reset the page total to zero, add the page total to the grand total, and write new page headers 12: Transaction Amount Accumulation - Add each qualifying transaction amount to the running page total and the running account total 13: Transaction Detail Line Writing - Format and write a single transaction detail line to the report containing transaction ID, account ID, transaction type code, transaction type description, category code, category description, transaction source, and transaction amount 14: End-of-File Page Total Writing - When the end of the transaction file is reached, write the final page total to the report and add it to the grand total 15: Grand Total Writing - Write the accumulated grand total of all transaction amounts across all pages and accounts to the report as the final summary line 16: Program Closure - Close all input files (Transaction, Card Cross-Reference, Transaction Type, Transaction Category, Date Parameter) and the output Report file after all processing is complete
